https://dev.roost.ai.core_purpose: The site provides automated, on-demand cloud environments for development, testing, and deployment, enabling teams to streamline their workflows and reduce infrastructure setup time.
business_requirements: Users must be able to create and manage cloud-based development environments on demand.
Users must be able to integrate the platform with their existing CI/CD pipelines and tools.
Users must be able to configure environment parameters, such as resource allocation and software dependencies, during setup.
Administrators must have the ability to monitor usage metrics and manage access controls for team members.
Users must be able to clone and replicate existing environments to test specific scenarios or features.
The platform must provide real-time status updates and notifications for environment setup and deployment processes.
Users must be able to archive or delete unused environments to optimize resource usage and reduce costs.
